'''Gramps''' (Japanese: '''じーじ''' ''Gramps'') is a {{p|Quagsire}} who appears in manga [[Magical Pokémon Journey]]. He first appears in ''[[PPPB16|The Hill of the Lone Star Tree]]'', searching for a {{p|Charmander}} named {{MPJ|Mandy}} with [[Carob]], his {{pkmn|Trainer}}.

Gramps tries to meet Mandy at the Lone Star Tree, where they promised to meet long ago.
